description: Get one Discond merchant by id: name, a short description when we have one, categories, providers, link and its branches. Pass the user's lat/lng when known so branches come nearest first, with distance. When the user is signed in to Discond, its top live offers are included.

business_id.description: Merchant id from discond_find_discounts or discond_autocomplete_businesses.

include_offers.description: Include live offers (signed-in users only). Default: true when signed in.

lat.description: User's latitude (with lng). Branches are then sorted nearest first.

name: discond_get_business
title: Get business
